headline: British Pumpkin Breaks World Record at Over 1.2 Tonnes
instagramCaption:
A British pumpkin has shattered the world record for weight.

According to GB News, the vegetable weighed over 1.2 tonnes during Halloween celebrations. This massive gourd achieved a new benchmark in agricultural growth.
The achievement highlights the potential for extreme produce cultivation.
